settings.question: How fast does it work?
settings.answer: Most women notice the burning and urgency start to ease within 24 to 48 hours. Keep taking 2 capsules daily with plenty of water for ongoing support.

settings.question: Can I take it every day?
settings.answer: Yes. Hey Girl D-Mannose is designed for daily use. Take 2 capsules a day to stay ahead of the next flare.

settings.question: Is this a replacement for antibiotics?
settings.answer: No. Hey Girl is a dietary supplement that supports urinary tract health. If you have an active infection, fever or severe symptoms, please see your doctor.

settings.question: Does it work better than cranberry?
settings.answer: Most cranberry pills are underdosed and rely on one ingredient. Hey Girl leads with 1,000mg of D-Mannose and adds Cranberry, Hibiscus and Dandelion for broader support.

settings.question: Will it interact with my medications?
settings.answer: D-Mannose is generally well tolerated, but if you take prescription medication or have a medical condition, check with your healthcare provider before starting any supplement.

settings.question: Is it safe during pregnancy?
settings.answer: Please talk to your doctor before taking any supplement while pregnant or breastfeeding.

settings.question: What does it taste like?
settings.answer: Nothing at all. It comes in small, easy-to-swallow veggie capsules with no taste or aftertaste.

settings.question: How many bottles should I start with?
settings.answer: One bottle is a 30-day supply. Most customers choose Subscribe & Save so they never run out and stay ahead of flares.
